[**MUSIC**](https://youtu.be/zPJwFWrfC58?si=8WABrcRd2XIB9dZ2)
Your crew stands terrified as the clouds seem to flow over the railings and in from above, consuming your vision. You begin to hear faint shouts and screams, the howling wind at this altitude making it difficult to make out anything other than the voices of your friends. You watch as one of the soldiers beside you who you have been traveling and bonding with over this month is ripped into the darkness by an unknown figure. As you feel something moving through he darkness around you the muffled cries of your friends ring out, you see Essek stumble into your vision, grasping onto your armor Emrys as he tries to stand but you realize he is bleeding from his shoulder. 

**ESSEK STATS**: 15/30HP, 12AC, +2 to saving throws, he can cast firebolt +3 to hit, 1d8 fire damage

He huffs and puffs as his wound runs red, "There's something out there, its devouring them, I barely escaped. It wasn't trying to kill me though, it tried to grab me." He manages to rise up if he is healed. As you try tog et your bearings, calling out to your allies you feel the ship rock and begin to tumble as if it is being grabbed and ripped from the sky, the nose tips forward and the ship feels like it is plummeting downwards. Everyone make a dexterity saving throw. The DC is 16, those who fail begin to slide towards the darkness at the ship's prow, and we roll initiative!

**ENEMIES**: [[valen drakovar.png]], 4x [Winter Wolf](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17061-winter-wolf)

Anyone who fell into the darkness, you take 9 bludgeoning damage as you slide and SLAM into the front of the ship, your life spared from falling by a piece of railing, but under your weight of the impact it begins to crack and bow. The ship begins to level out, make a perception check
16 or higher: You see what appears to be an arm of darkness reaching up from a large pillar far below you on the ground, and a fist wrapped around the ship, this is an ambush. As you steady yourself and begin to stand as the shit returns to its normal state you see what appears to be a man with long black hair and a blood red cape flying upwards into the darkness, towards where your friends were. 
You hear nothing around you but death, the screams of men as their throats are ripped out, the clashing of steel against steel. You stand ready and see your friends who slipped and fell when the ship did sprint back to you, joining you as you all stand back to back facing the darkness.
*Let them all take a turn before revealing anything.*
You hear a low, rumbling, ancient laugh echo out through the fog, as if coming from every direction. "Antigone... tell me, how long did you think you could run... from your blood? I am sorry cousin, Madam Rex did not send me here to bring you home, she sent me to kill you, and your cows are in my way."
He explodes out of the darkness and attacks Emrys and Fargrim each, then second round of combat begins normally.

**Valen Dialogues**:
- If he downs someone, "A shame, you had so much more blood for me to feast upon."
- If Antigone goes down, "Come now Antigone, with your bloodline, there is so much more you can do, get up, show me!" He reaches down and pours a potion of blood and healing into your mouth, healing you for 30 points, and allowing you to activate one of your blood abilities.
- If he gets critted, "Haha! Finally, showing signs of life, I can feel your blood pumping!"
- If he crits, "Feel the power of the immortal! You are nothing but pigs for me to drink from hahahaha!"
- Evan: He raises his hand to slash at someone in the party, just as you see the green armored Evan Petlia rise up behind him, about to cleave Valen's head from his shoulders. Just as his sword comes forward Valen smiles, as the blade stops, and Evan collapses to the ground, Valen holding a dagger backwards, stabbed into his chest. As he collapses, Mushy falls to the ground reaching for his sword, but Valen laughs, kicking Mushy off the side of the ship and into the darkness.

When the battle starts to draw on, and he goes below half or gets in danger, he will escape and kidnap Essek, and he will snatch the bag of mirror holding as well. 
Make a perception check against a 30 Slight of Hand. 

As he dissipates into a cloud of black smoke along with Essek, the darkness fades, showing the bloody painting of bodies and stains across the decks. There is nobody left standing on top deck besides the party and Mervin, who appears to be unconscious and badly wounded. 

**Mervin**: (Making death saves)
- When he comes to, "What the hells? Like some kind of cloud? What happened?"
- About his power, "I don't know what's happening, it was like my connection to Illuman was weakened, and then when that cloud got me it was like it stopped completely... I was helpless."
- "I don't know what happened, but by Illuman's light I'm gonna find and gut that bastard. There's something wrong in the heavens though, that shouldn't be possible to take my power like that."
